summary: Select the first cyan cell in row-major order. Find the global bounding box of every cell whose value is neither zero nor cyan; take the value at that box's top-left coordinate as the frame color and the first row-major nonzero/non-cyan value that differs from it as the interior color, falling back to the frame color. Expand the box to include the cyan cell, paint its perimeter with the frame color and its strict interior with the interior color, and set every cell outside the expanded box to zero.
